predictions.selection_reason: configuration string with @{...} pattern -> lookup of other configuration values -> potential circular reference or data exposure
predictions.source_summary: Configuration values from user-provided configObj parameter in parse() function
predictions.sink_summary: Returns the looked-up value which gets substituted into configuration strings, potentially reaching other interpreters like ExecutionInterpreter which uses vm.runInNewContext()
predictions.guard_summary: No validation on the key path; getValue returns undefined for missing keys but doesn't prevent access to any existing keys
predictions.risk_pattern: Unrestricted configuration reference lookup allows arbitrary property access in configuration object, enabling potential prototype pollution or access to sensitive configuration values when combined with other interpreters
predictions.context_summary: ReferenceInterpreter processes @{key.path} patterns by looking up values from the configuration object using dot notation paths. The lookup is recursive and can access nested properties without restrictions.
unresolved_facts: Whether configuration data comes from untrusted sources
Whether the configuration object contains sensitive values that should not be exposed via reference lookups

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
top_sast_rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.

top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.
